To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

satellite observations of the troposphere NO2 vertical column densities (VCDs) can be used to monitor the anthropogenic NOx emission changes over East Asia, and the updated Regional Emissions inventory in ASia can reproduce the observed trends in NO2 VCs.
the rate of NOx emissions increase over East Asia during 2000–2009 was 11%/yr, with the exception of Japan where a decline of 2%/yr was found.
anthropogenic NOx emission in China increased from 2000 to 2010, with the exception of a slight decrease in 2009.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a systematic validation of regional modeling and estimation of NOx emissions using multisatellite observations.
the development of a method to estimate emissions of anthropogenic NO2 VCD from satellite observations and the application of this method to the East Asia region.
the validation of the updated REAS emission inventory and the estimation of emissions in China during the period 2010–2012.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the updated REAS version 2.2, with the revised emissions above the CEC region, would be suitable for use as a regional emission inventory for the East Asian region.

anthropogenic NOx emission trends estimated using our model and the updated REAS are consistent with the multisatellite observation data, and that the updated REAS can be used to reliably estimate the anthropogenic emissions of NOx in China.
satellite observations can be used to provide useful information on the temporal and spatial variation of NO2 VCD in East Asia, and thus to provide a valuable constraint on anthropogenic emissions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our results suggest the possibility to estimate NOx emissions from satellite observations of NO2 VCD.
satellite observations are a powerful tool to estimate the temporal and spatial variation of surface NOx emissions.
our study has provided a reliable estimation of anthropogenic NO2 VCD over East Asia during 2000– 2010.
The main takeaway from our work is that
multisatellite NO2 VCD observations provide a robust means for estimating NOx emissions in East Asia.
the updated REAS emission inventory provides reasonable estimations of NO2 VCD in East Asia and that the rate of growth of NOx emissions in China during the past decade is robust.
the satellite observations can be used to evaluate and improve emission inventories.
